text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I hear you, my adoring fans, I hear you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All these voices ringing out in eager
anticipation
of the appearance of the
model student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! The perfect class
representative,
heading out!
choice_data_list: 最高の走りを見せてこい！
最高の走りを見せてきて！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You have my word as class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Under the rules of Umamusume
sportsmanship, I
vow to set a great
example with a great Bakushin,
fair and
square!
